# `inline`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Explodes an array of structs into a table. Uses column names col1, col2, etc. by default unless specified otherwise.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
inline(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `generator_funcs` |
| Kind | generator (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- inline, example 1
> SELECT inline(array(struct(1, 'a'), struct(2, 'b')));
1 | a
2 | b
```

```sql
-- inline, example 2
> SELECT inline(input => array(struct(1, 'a'), struct(2, 'b')));
1 | a
2 | b
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
